decisions.reason: Established defect: native R1 is 10 kΩ between /IN and /OUT. The specified external equipment continuously maintains 48 V across it, producing I=4.8 mA and P=48²/10000=0.2304 W, or 2.304 times the declared 0.1 W limit. The alternative 0.002304 W calculation is incorrect by a factor of 100. Clean ERC/DRC results do not evaluate this continuous power criterion.
